arguments.sql:
-- Step 1: Check how many employees have pay history
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT businessentityid) FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory;

-- Step 2: Check employees in target departments
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh
INNER JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
WHERE d.name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control') AND edh.enddate IS NULL;

-- Step 3: Check employees with both pay and department
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM humanresources.employeenameview env
INNER JOIN humanresources.employeepayhistory eph ON env.businessentityid = eph.businessentityid
INNER JOIN humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh ON env.businessentityid = edh.businessentityid
INNER JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
WHERE d.name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control') AND edh.enddate IS NULL;
